description: Replace the list of routines: small steps that repeat on fixed weekdays. From today on, each one appears as a plan item on its days; tick it with edit_plan_item, skip it for one day with delete_plan_item. set_plan keeps them. days are ISO weekdays 1=Mon..7=Sun, default every day. perWeek makes it a weekly count: each tick adds its count (default 1), and once the week reaches perWeek it leaves the plan until Monday. Link it to the goal with leverId. minimum is the small version for a bad day ("read one thread" for "talk to one person"). Pass existing ids to keep them.

minimum.description: the bad-day version, e.g. "read one thread"

perWeek.description: weekly count, e.g. 5 for "talk to 5 people a week"

name: set_routines
title: Set routines
